summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload via alternate runtime
details: The package declares a preinstall script (scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs") that downloads the Bun runtime from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases into a temp directory, marks it executable, and uses that freshly downloaded runtime to execute the shipped math_init.js file on the installer's host. math_init.js is a ~727KB heavily obfuscated file using a shuffled string-array rotator (`WV8StW(arr, n){ for(...) arr.push(arr.shift()); }`) and mangled identifiers, concealing the actual behavior and network destinations. The advertised purpose of the package is a React/mobx feature-flag library, which has no legitimate need for a second language runtime or an opaque 727KB payload. This is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: the malicious payload is invoked via a downloaded alien runtime, bypassing Node-based tooling, and fires automatically on `npm install`. The tarball additionally ships with `"author": ""` in package.json, and the dropper is bolted onto an otherwise plausible ServiceTitan library — consistent with a scope hijack or compromised-maintainer publish under the @servicetitan namespace.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
